text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-d-d-r-e-s-s-e-d t-h-e c-o-m-p-l-a-i-n-t a-b-o-u-t t-h-e s-a-f-e-t-y f-a-i-l-u-r-e, l-e-f-t a m-e-t-i-n-g t-r-a-n-s-c-r-i-p-t, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y s-a-f-e-t-y a-u-d-i-t c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-t-t-e-m-p-t-e-d t-o r-e-v-i-s-e t-h-e l-a-b f-i-n-d-i-n-g s, l-e-f-t d-r-a-f-t e-d-i-t-s o-f t-h-e o-r-i-g-i-n-a-l r-e-p-o-r-t-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-r-y-e-d t-o r-e-p-l-a-c-e t-h-e v-a-l-i-d c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n m-a-r-k-s, l-e-f-t o-l-d c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-e s a-n-d p-r-o-o-f o-f a-c-c-e-s-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r y c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r w-o-r-k-e-d o-n r-e-l-a-b-e-l-i-n-g t-h-e a-g-e w-a-r-n-i-n-g-s, l-e-f-t n-e-w l-a-b-e-l i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r y a-n-d p-a-c-k-a-g-i-n-g o-f t-h-e i-t-e-m-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e q-u-a-l-i-t-y a-s-s-u-r-a-n-c-e s-a-m-p-l-i-n-g r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-r-e-p-a-r-e-d t-o r-e-s-e-l-l t-h-e i-t-e-m-s, l-e-f-t i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r y r-e-c-o-r-d-s a-n-d s-a-l-e-s i-n-t-e-n-t i-o-n d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-r-k-e-t-p-l-a-c-e s-u-r-v-e-i-l-l-a-n-c-e a-n-d p-r-o-d-u-c-t r-e-c-a-l-l p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e c-h-e-c-k.
